# Tazarzit Bio (تازارزيت بيو)

> Moroccan natural foods from the Souss region: Amlou, edible argan oil, honey, and honey-nuts. Cash on delivery (COD) across Morocco.

Website: https://www.tazarzitbio.com
Brand: Tazarzit Bio / تازارزيت بيو
Languages: Arabic (primary), French, English (UI)
Payment: Cash on delivery only — no prepaid card required
Shipping: Morocco nationwide

## What we sell

- **Amlou (أملو)**: Traditional Souss spread — typically roasted almonds, edible argan oil, and honey. Flagship shop page: https://www.tazarzitbio.com/amlouroyal
- **Edible argan oil (زيت الأركان الغذائي)**: Food-grade argan oil from Morocco (distinct from cosmetic argan oil)
- **Natural honey (عسل طبيعي)**: Including regional honeys such as Daghmous-style offerings
- **Honey & nuts**: Natural combinations for breakfast and hospitality
